Asta Reborn With His Memories Meets Liebe At Age 10
description:
What if Asta was reborn in the church at Hage with every memory of his first life, the Spade raid, the final battle, and the brother sealed inside the grimoire tower wall? He is a baby with no magic, only anti-magic. And this time he already knows what he is going to do about it.

A full-cast Black Clover What-If audio drama (voiced with Fish Audio). Part 1 follows the boy who reads the wind, the night he walks into the tower to meet Liebe, the contract between equals, and the exam that already happened, with Yami, Noelle, a masked William Vangeance and a Midnight Sun cliffhanger.
